hero.purpose: One per page: home statement or application marketing panel. Never inside a card.

heading.purpose: Page and dialog titles; the largest in-product heading.

section.purpose: Card titles and section headings; the workhorse heading of a dense screen.

metric.purpose: A single KPI value, always set in tabular numerals and paired with a caption.

interface.purpose: Body copy, controls, navigation and table cells — the default reading size.

caption.purpose: Metadata, helper text, badges and timestamps. The 12px floor.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on an input or popup trigger; the first step of a menu.

shadows.name: shadow-base
shadows.purpose: A raised inline surface that is not yet an overlay.

shadows.name: shadow-xl
shadows.purpose: Dialog and menu panel; the default float in component recipes.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and border state changes on controls.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover, focus and open states.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Larger surface transitions; never an entrance effect.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Blue solid, 28px, for the one action a region exists for.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-blue-8); color: var(--ink-base); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--surface-blue-9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--surface-blue-9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-outline-blue); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-blue-4); color: var(--ink-base); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel Gray fill with Ink Secondary text; the default button for most actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-8); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-gray-3); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-gray-4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-outline-default); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Canvas White with a Border outline; for a second action that still needs a boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-2); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--ink-gray-8); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--outline-gray-3); } .ds-btn-outline:active { border-color: var(--outline-gray-3); background: var(--surface-gray-4); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-outline-default); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 28px outline field with the shared label and caption contract.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--ink-gray-8); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; } .ds-field-input { height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-2); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--surface-base); color: var(--ink-gray-9); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-gray-6); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: var(--outline-gray-3); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--outline-gray-4); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); outline: var(--focus-outline-default); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-field-input:disabled { background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-6); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat 8px surface with a 1px border and 12–20px padding; no shadow at rest.
components.html:
Revenue overview

Paid transactions, refunds and net revenue for the selected period.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: var(--spacing-3); border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-1); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--surface-elevation-1); color: var(--ink-gray-9); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-gray-6); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 18px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A full pill at 20px with a 12px label; reads as status, never as a button.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 20px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-6); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { background: var(--surface-green-2); color: var(--ink-green-8); }

components.name: Dialog Panel
components.description: 12px opaque panel with a border and the one shadow that means float.
components.html:
Delete this view?

The saved filters will be removed for everyone in this workspace.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 420px; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); padding: var(--spacing-4); border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-1); border-radius: var(--radius-overlay); background: var(--surface-elevation-1); color: var(--ink-gray-9); box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl); font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 8px 0 16px; color: var(--ink-gray-7); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 20px; } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-secondary, .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-8); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-gray-3); } .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--surface-red-8); color: var(--ink-base); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--surface-red-9); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-outline-default); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: 32px row, 8px radius, 14px label; current is a wash plus Ink.
components.html: AtomsMoleculesOrganisms
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 224px; font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-card); color: var(--ink-gray-7); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 420; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-9); } .ds-nav-current { background: var(--surface-gray-2); color: var(--ink-gray-9); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: var(--focus-outline-default); outline-offset: 0; }

narrative.overview:
newui is a working surface, not a showcase. It is built for people who spend the day inside business software — ledgers, queues, dashboards, settings — and it assumes the screen is a tool they operate rather than a page they admire. Density is the default: controls are 28px, interface text is 14px, captions are 12px, every gap lands on a 4px rhythm, and a table row earns its height from its content rather than from air. Structure is drawn with 1px borders and type. Colour is a signal, not an atmosphere.

The mood is compact and workmanlike. Nothing is decorative for its own sake: there are no gradient meshes, no glass panels, no illustration holding up a product claim. Cool Paper neutrals keep the canvas distinct from white cards without turning the page beige. Signal Blue marks action and selection and almost nothing else; a reader should be able to find the one thing they can do on a screen by following the blue. Headings tighten as they grow, numbers are tabular, and motion is a state change rather than an entrance.

The same system runs the library and the documentation site that demonstrates it. A reference page is not a special case of the brand: it is the product's card, row, badge and field vocabulary applied to prose and code. That is why the site's chrome imports no component — the shell is plain markup over the same semantic tokens a consumer uses.
keyCharacteristics: Density as the default. 28px controls, 32px navigation rows, 14/20 interface text; compact is the normal setting, not a "small" variant.
One working accent. Signal Blue is reserved for action, selection and focus; status has its own three colours and data can borrow violet.
Border-first depth. Cards are flat with a 1px outline; only genuinely floating surfaces carry a shadow.
Inter at 420. Body text sits a hair above regular; hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking, never from a second typeface.
States are visible without colour alone. Error carries a message, selection carries aria-current or data-state, focus carries an outline.
Documentation chrome equals product chrome. The site is built from the same tokens, radii and spacing roles it documents.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is for action and selection. If a blue element cannot be clicked, cannot be selected, or does not indicate where the reader is, it is the wrong colour. Status uses green, amber or red; category uses violet.

rules.name: The No Raw Ramp Rule
rules.body: Components reference semantic roles — surface-*, ink-*, outline-* — never a palette step such as blue-700 or a hex value. A component that needs a new colour needs a semantic token first.

rules.name: The AA Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every foreground/background pairing a recipe can ship is asserted against WCAG AA in both themes. A pairing that fails is a legibility bug, not a taste call.

rules.name: The 420 Rule
rules.body: Body text is 420, not 400. Medium is 500 and semibold is 600. Do not fake weight with text-shadow or synthetic bolding; the variable font already carries the steps.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Negative tracking belongs to 18px and above. Body and caption text stay at 0; shrinking a small label with negative tracking is how dense interfaces become unreadable.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Any number that can sit in a column — money, counts, percentages, durations — uses tabular numerals. Proportional figures are for prose, not for a table or a KPI.

rules.name: The Named Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Use the role — gap-section-gap, p-card-pad-compact, gap-control-gap — not a one-off p-4. A new spacing value is a token decision, not a component decision.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose stays at or under 30rem (≈78 characters at 14px). A paragraph that runs the full 768px column is a bug; tables, code and previews are not prose and keep the column.

rules.name: The Two-Rail Rule
rules.body: The 224px sidebar and the 48px rail present the same navigation model. Collapsing changes the presentation, never the destinations or the reading order.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means the element floats; if it does not overlap the page, it does not get one.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Outline Rule
rules.body: Focus is a 2px outline (3px in dark mode), not a box-shadow. It therefore survives forced-colours mode, never collides with a shadow-* utility, and stays visible on every surface — including a solid blue button.

rules.name: The Three-Radius Rule
rules.body: 6, 8, 12 — control, card, overlay. A fourth radius is specialized geometry (a chart mark, an avatar), not a surface decision. When in doubt, use the role name rather than a number.

dos: Do use semantic roles — bg-surface-base, text-ink-gray-9, border-outline-gray-1 — for every colour.
Do use the named rhythm roles (p-card-pad, gap-section-gap, gap-control-gap) instead of arbitrary spacing utilities.
Do keep Signal Blue for the action, the selection and the current location; let everything else be neutral.
Do pair every error with a message and aria-invalid, and every status with a label or icon.
Do keep the 28px default control and the 24/28/32/40 height scale; use 40–44px targets for primary touch actions.
Do set metrics and table figures in tabular numerals.
Do hold long-form prose to the 30rem reading measure, and let tables, code and demos keep the full column.
Do verify both themes and the 390 / 768 / 1440 widths before calling a screen done.
donts: Don't use a raw palette step, hex, rgb() or hsl() value in a component; add a semantic token first.
Don't use theme to mean light/dark. theme is the colour axis; colorScheme owns the mode.
Don't put a shadow on a resting card or use elevation as decoration.
Don't add a second accent for visual interest, or use blue for a non-interactive label.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradient meshes, glow, or hero illustration as product chrome.
Don't shrink informative text below 12px or touch targets below 40px.
Don't set navigation labels in tracked uppercase, or tighten small text with negative tracking.
Don't invent a radius, a control height or a one-off spacing value when a role already exists.
